title: HR Data Engineering Analyst
description:
HR Data Engineering Analyst – Snowflake
Toronto – Fully onsite 5 days per week

Position Summary:
We are seeking a proactive and technically proficient HR Data Engineering Analyst to join our Human Resources Shared Services team. This role will focus exclusively on enabling HR data solutions and reporting capabilities across our global workforce by leveraging Snowflake as the centralized enterprise data platform.

The ideal candidate will support the ingestion, modeling, and optimization of HR data assets—such as employee demographics, compensation, benefits, time tracking, and payroll—ensuring accuracy, scalability, and alignment with enterprise-wide reporting and compliance requirements. This role provides an excellent opportunity to build foundational expertise in cloud data engineering within a mission-critical function.

Responsibilities:
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT data pipelines in Snowflake to support HR analytics, compliance, and operational reporting
  • Support the integration and transformation of data from HRIS, payroll, benefits administration, and third-party vendors into Snowflake
  • Develop and optimize HR data models , ensuring efficient structures for reporting on headcount, turnover, benefits, compensation, and organizational structure
  • Partner with HRIS, Total Rewards, Payroll, and Workforce Planning teams to understand data needs and develop scalable solutions
  • Ensure data quality, validation, and reconciliation across systems, including control frameworks for sensitive and regulated data
  • Assist with building secure, governed data views for internal stakeholders while complying with data privacy and protection policies (e.g., PII, GDPR)
  • Document technical specifications, data dictionaries, and transformation logic for HR datasets and workflows
  • Support troubleshooting, monitoring, and performance tuning of Snowflake processes and queries
  • Contribute to agile sprint planning and execution as part of the HR Technology or HR Analytics function
  • Maintain familiarity with evolving HR data standards and reporting regulations (e.g., EEO, DEI, ACA, OSHA)

Requirements:
  • 1–3 years of experience in data engineering , HR analytics , or HR systems (internships/co-ops considered)
  • Strong SQL proficiency; working knowledge of Python for scripting and automation
  • Hands-on exposure to Snowflake , including schema design, data loading, and query optimization
  • Familiarity with common HR systems (e.g., Workday, UKG, ADP, or similar) and HR data structures
  • Understanding of ETL/ELT workflows , data modeling , and integration design

Bonus points if you have:
  • Experience with data orchestration tools such as Workato, dbt, or similar preferred
  • Snowflake or cloud platform certification is a plus

title: Frontend Lead Architect (Hands On)
description:
Frontend Lead Architect (Hands On)
Location: Dallas area (Hybrid)
Compensation: $160K-$180K

Company Summary
We are a digital engineering services firm specializing in building scalable, cloud-native enterprise applications. Our teams deliver innovative solutions across industries such as retail, eCommerce, financial services, and SaaS. With a strong focus on agility, architecture excellence, and client collaboration, we help organizations modernize their technology platforms and deliver exceptional user experiences.

Position Summary
We are seeking a Frontend Lead Architect/Developer to lead the design and development of modern, scalable web applications. This role is hands-on, with responsibility for building micro frontend architectures, reusable UI systems, and performance-optimized applications. The ideal candidate has strong technical leadership, thrives in Agile consulting environments, and is comfortable engaging with both technical teams and business stakeholders.

Responsibilities
· Architect and implement scalable frontend applications using ReactJS and Module Federation.
· Design and maintain reusable UI components and centralized design systems.
· Build and deploy micro frontend applications that integrate across teams.
· Optimize performance, troubleshoot bottlenecks, and manage build processes with Webpack.
· Collaborate with backend and DevOps teams on API integration and CI/CD pipelines.
· Partner with business stakeholders to estimate and design effective technical solutions.
· Mentor team members and enforce frontend best practices.
· Support POC development and documentation as needed.
· Contribute in Agile/Scrum environments with cross-functional teams.
· Be flexible for occasional domestic/international travel for client needs.

Requirements
· 8+ years in frontend development.
· Advanced proficiency in React, Redux, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS, Tailwind.
· Hands-on experience with Webpack, Micro Frontends, Module Federation.
· Proven success with design systems and reusable UI libraries.
· Familiarity with SQL (Oracle) and NoSQL (Cassandra).
· Experience with Git, Jenkins, Stash, CI/CD pipelines.
· Bonus: React Native, eCommerce/retail projects, AWS integration.
· Strong communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills.
· Ability to travel for client needs (domestic/international).

title: Process Engineer
description:
Position: Process Engineer – 2 Openings: Senior and Junior-Level
Industry: Chemical Manufacturing
Location: Memphis, TN

Company Summary
Our client is a specialty chemical manufacturer with a long history of innovation and sustainable chemistry solutions. With operations focused on scaling lab-based research into full-scale production, the company emphasizes safety, environmental responsibility, and continuous process optimization. Their culture values perseverance, accountability, and entrepreneurial spirit, making it an ideal environment for engineers who thrive on solving complex technical challenges.

Position Summary
The Production Process Engineer will play a critical role in bridging R&D and manufacturing. This position is responsible for scaling processes from lab and pilot plant to full production, optimizing existing manufacturing operations, and driving continuous improvements in quality, yield, energy, and cost efficiency. The engineer will also provide troubleshooting support, lead small-scale capital projects, train operations staff, and ensure compliance with all safety and environmental standards.

Responsibilities
· Scale up new processes from R&D to production equipment.
· Drive process optimizations to improve efficiency, yields, and product quality.
· Troubleshoot process issues and apply root cause analysis.
· Lead small to medium capital projects (design, estimate, install).
· Train and mentor technicians/operators on processes and safety.
· Support startups and process modifications, including documentation and SOPs.
· Monitor inventories, yields, and process control systems.
· Ensure compliance with safety, PSM, and environmental standards.
· Provide technical leadership in separations, distillation, reaction kinetics, and process modeling.

Qualifications
· BS or higher in Chemical Engineering.
· 3–10 years process/production engineering in chemical manufacturing.
· Strong experience with distillation, separation techniques, and reaction chemistry.
· Scale-up experience (lab → pilot → commercial).
· Familiarity with DCS systems (DeltaV, APACS) and process modeling tools (CHEMCAD, Aspen, etc.).
· Exposure to ISO, cGMP, or API quality systems a plus.
· Demonstrated leadership and ability to mentor.
· Strong documentation, communication, and cross-functional teamwork skills.
